messages:
Alex M: Quick ask — running a hybrid k6+Locust replay next Thu 9pm PST. Goal: 100k total virtual users, split 70/30 k6/Locust. Need help deciding sample rate, shard assignments, and KV cache warmup plan. Who can own the shard table and a quick preflight run?

Sara T: How long is the replay window? steady 30m ramp 15m? also what's our p95 target for gen (ms)?

Alex M: 30m steady with 15m ramp up/down. p95 target 300ms end-to-end for hosted tier, allow higher for dedicated.

Matt R: I can own shard assignments. Proposed sharding YAML:
```yaml
shards:
  count: 10
  strategy: range
  k6_shards: 7
  locust_shards: 3
  seed: 20240315
```
We'll map user IDs to shard = hash(id) % count.

Jen K: I'll run a 10% warmup earlier in the day and upload flamegraphs. @Matt R can you add a kv-warmup stage: 10k keys read with concurrency 200 for 5m?

Ravi P: Reminder: KV cache TTL means cold starts can hit db. Add prefix caching and a 5m steady prewarm. Also watch socket fd/ephemeral port exhaustion on machines.

replay-bot: preflight check results: infra quotas OK, 2000 ephemeral ports free on pool-12, disk iops baseline within acceptable range. :white_check_mark:

Sara T: for profiling, capture perf + eBPF during the 10% run. Jen, I can help with perf scripts. Let's record p50/p95/cpu%/iowait every 30s to grafana: https://grafana.company.local/d/abcd/replay

Alex M: Awesome. Matt, can you push shard YAML to the replay repo by EOD and tag @jen for the warmups? I'll schedule the main run Thu 9pm PST if no blockers. :thumbsup:

Matt R: will do, pushing in 10m.

Jen K: got it. I'll queue warmup test for Thu 3pm PST and post results in this thread. :eyes:
